Use a flexible, non-stretch tape against bare skin. Keep it level and snug without compressing the skin. Measure under the same conditions each time and record consistently in your selected unit.
Used for circumference entry and display. Stored measurements remain unchanged when this preference changes.
Wrap just below the Adam’s apple, keeping the tape level and shoulders relaxed.
Measure around the fullest chest point, tape level, after a normal exhale.
Measure midway between the lowest rib and top of the hip bone after a normal exhale; do not pull in your stomach.
Stand with feet together and measure around the widest point of the buttocks.
Let the arm hang relaxed and measure midway between shoulder and elbow. Use the same side each time.
Stand evenly and measure the widest upper-thigh point. Use the same side each time.
Measure around the widest calf point while standing evenly. Use the same side each time.

See what changed in Calorie Quick %1$s
A smoother test and review loop
The Android Back key now returns secondary screens to the daily overview instead of minimizing the app.
Quick-add sheets no longer compete with vertical scrolling for drag gestures.
Open Food Facts lookups now record privacy-safe timing and outcome diagnostics for review.
Review exports can be triaged in the new private Windows review inbox before anything is promoted for implementation.
Review exports now include a versioned root manifest, explicit selection details, and integrity hashes for every image.
Exported review images are orientation-corrected, resized, and stripped of camera, location, and editing metadata.
Every support bundle records the exact app build and source revision that produced it.
Release notes are now built in
Browse a permanent, offline What’s new history from Settings.
See a concise summary once after each installed app upgrade.
Includes the new backup, feedback-image, diagnostic, and layout improvements from the latest test builds.
Uses an explicit white launcher-icon background for consistent display across Android devices.
Browse Files and Downloads directly when attaching images, in addition to Photos and Albums.
Improves upward catalogue scrolling and makes this release summary scrollable on smaller screens.
Safer field testing and clearer feedback
Create and preview complete backups, then restore profile, diary, personal catalogue, recipes, measurements, images, preferences, and feedback.
Attach an optional image to a feedback message and include it in the review export.
Today’s date and all four action icons now share one aligned header row.
The nutrition sheet now breaks the day down by logged item.
Crash and background-freeze reports can be bundled explicitly for support.
Food search always offers manual entry, and liquid measures are easier to use.
